title: Movement & Directions
intro: As toddlers gain mobility, their language naturally shifts to movement and pointing out locations. Today we add 3 fundamental movement/location words and mix them with Days 1 & 2.

words.babyAnalogy: Beckoning gesture with hands to call someone over.
words.actionTag: Calling domestic help, colleague, or friend: 'Illi banni!' (Come here!).

words.babyAnalogy: Waving bye-bye or pointing towards an exit.
words.actionTag: Say 'Alli hogi' (Go there) or 'Hogi banni' (Go and come back / Goodbye).

words.babyAnalogy: Pointing right next to oneself vs pointing far away.
words.actionTag: Point near and say 'Illi', point far and say 'Alli'.

combos.context: Directing someone to a specific spot.

quiz.scenario: You want your colleague or domestic worker to come over to your desk.
quiz.question: What phrase do you use while beckoning gently?

quiz.scenario: You want to tell a delivery agent to place the package right here.
quiz.question: How do you say 'I want it here!'?

quiz.scenario: You greet someone politely and invite them over.
quiz.question: What is the combined phrase?
